quests.title: Salt on the Wind
quests.summary: Catch three fish off the Hearthbay dock.
intro: You'll be the new tenant, then. Bait shop's yours till somebody says otherwise.
Rod's on the hook by the door. Your aunt's, it was. Go on, end of the dock.
Hold to cast, let go in the bright bit. Bring me three fish and I'll show you how we do things.

objectives.label: Catch 3 fish

quests.reminder: Three fish, love. End of the dock. I'll be right here, pretending not to watch.
outro: Three! And none of them looking at you funny. Good start.
I'll buy what you catch, right here at the stall. Fair prices. Mostly fair.

quests.title: Supper for the Village
quests.summary: Sell eight fish at Mara's stall.
intro: Half the village eats what comes off this dock. Lately it's been… thin.
Sell me eight fish. The bigger the better. The odder the better, honestly.

objectives.label: Sell 8 fish

quests.reminder: Eight fish for the stall. Bring them here and I'll do the sums.
outro: That'll feed the Pollards and then some. Here, you've earned a look at the good shelf.
And the notice board by the stall's got odd jobs, if you want more coin. Folk pay well for strange requests.

quests.title: A Proper Rod
quests.summary: Buy the Harbour Rod from Mara's shop.
intro: That driftwood stick will snap the first time something with opinions bites.
Harbour Rod. Four hundred and fifty. I'll even throw in some worms.

objectives.label: Buy the Harbour Rod

quests.reminder: Harbour Rod's on the good shelf. Four-fifty. I don't haggle. Much.
outro: Now you look like you mean it. Worms are in the tin. Don't open it indoors.

quests.title: Wick's Drawing
quests.summary: Catch the pink fish from Wick's drawing.
intro: Look! I drew it before I saw it. That means it's real. That's how it works.
It's pink and it bites sunsets. It lives near the cove or the Teeth. Catch it? Please?

objectives.label: Catch a Coral Snapper

quests.reminder: The pink one! Near the cove or the Teeth. It likes sunsets best.
outro: It looks EXACTLY like my drawing! Except it has fewer legs. I'll fix that.

quests.title: The Dark Lamp
quests.summary: Catch a Lampjaw after dusk.
intro: The light on Gull Point's been dark since the keeper went down. Down, I said. Not away.
A lamp like that won't take ordinary oil. It wants a light the sea made.
Lampjaw. After the sun's gone. Bring me one.

objectives.label: Catch a Lampjaw at night

quests.reminder: Lampjaw only shows once the sun's gone. Be patient. The sea is.
outro: There. Still warm. Hold onto it, it'll want to go home.

quests.title: Relight
quests.summary: Climb the lighthouse on Gull Point and light the lamp.
intro: Up the stairs, all the way. Put the light where the light goes.
And when it catches, don't look at the water. Not straight away.

objectives.label: Light the Gull Point lamp

quests.reminder: I'll row you out to Gull Point when you're ready. Just say.
outro: There she is. Hearthbay's been holding its breath a long while.
You saw it, didn't you. In the water. Two of them.
Good. Then you're the keeper now. Nobody chooses it. Take the skiff, it was hers.

quests.title: A Kettle on the Shore
quests.summary: Sail the skiff out to Kettle Isle, west of the cove, and find the keeper's kettle.
intro: She's light on the helm. Push her on and she goes, let her be and she glides. Never cast till she's settled.
South-west of here there's an isle with a kettle on it. The keeper took her tea there, tides she wanted quiet.
Go and see if it's still warm. It will be. That's the part I don't care for.

objectives.label: Sail to Kettle Isle, west of the cove, and find the kettle

quests.reminder: Kettle Isle. West of the cove, out past its mouth. You'll know the beach.
outro: Warm, was it. Twelve winters on a bare rock, and warm.
Keep it. Her things go to whoever keeps the light.

quests.title: What Bites at the Teeth
quests.summary: Sail south-west to the Teeth and catch a Twofold Flounder.
intro: So he's given you the skiff. Good. It's sat at that dock like a held breath.
South-west there's three black rocks, the Teeth. Deep water. Nothing off them has reached my stall in a long while.
Bring me a Twofold Flounder. And don't let it look at you with both faces at once.

objectives.label: Catch a Twofold Flounder at the Teeth

quests.reminder: The Teeth, south-west past the sandbar. Flounder sit deep, so give it line.
outro: Oh, that's the one. Look at it. Looking at us.
My sister brought these in by the basket. I don't know why I said that. I haven't got a sister.

quests.title: A Full Stall
quests.summary: Keep Mara's stall full: sell 6,000 coins' worth of fish.
intro: Word's got round that there's fish on my stall again. Proper fish, deep-water fish. I've had people at the door before light.
Keep it full for me. Six thousand coins' worth across this counter, and the village eats well till the cold.
There's a hat in the back that's been waiting for somebody. I'd say whose, if I could think.

objectives.label: Sell 6,000 coins' worth of fish

quests.reminder: Keep the stall full. Deep water pays best, so mind the Teeth.
outro: Six thousand. I've not written a number like that in this book since... well. There's no since. It's a new book.
Here. It fits you. I knew it would, and I can't think how I knew.

quests.title: Lanterns in the Water
quests.summary: Set the Lantern Pot in the water, let it fish while you do, and haul it up.
intro: Your aunt kept lantern pots off this dock. A light in a basket. Fish swim in to look, and can't think how to leave.
There's one left in the shed. Set it in the water and it fishes while you do. Only fish it's seen you catch, mind. It learns from you.
And it only works while you're about. Leave it a night and you'll find it just as you left it. Don't ask me why.

objectives.label: Haul 3 fish from a Lantern Pot

quests.reminder: Set the pot in the water, give it a while, then go and haul it up. It won't come to you.
outro: There. Small fish, pot fish. But they sell, and you never lifted a rod.
I've more pots if you want them, and brighter wicks. I'll put them out on the stall.

quests.title: Whose Cat
quests.summary: Catch Biscuit one each of the three fish she has asked for, all to be had off the Hearthbay dock, and she will sign on aboard your boat.
intro: Biscuit isn't anybody's. I asked. She said she'd think about it if there was fish.
She wants one of each. A butterperch, a pebble goby and a coral snapper. The ones off her own dock. I drew them so you'd know. She sat on the drawing.
She keeps looking at your boat. She's never been on a boat. I think she's been on yours, though. Before.

objectives.label: Catch a Butterperch for Biscuit
Catch a Pebble Goby for Biscuit
Catch a Coral Snapper for Biscuit

quests.reminder: One of each! Butterperch, pebble goby, coral snapper. Off the dock. She's counting. She can count to three.
outro: She ate the butterperch first. That means yes. The goby's for later and the snapper's for looking at.
She's your boat's cat now. When the boat's stopped she'll hook fish out for you. She eats some. That's her wages.
Watch her tail when you're fishing. It goes before the float does. She knows already. She always knows already.

quests.title: The Drowned Bell
quests.summary: Sail north-west past Gull Point and find the bell the sea left standing.
intro: You've the kettle, and Mara's had her flounder. That's the bay, as far as coins will take you.
North-west, past Gull Point, a belfry stands in the sea with its bell still in it. The water took the church. It left the bell.
Go and look at it. Only look. I'll tell you the rest when you've seen it's real.

objectives.label: Sail north-west past Gull Point and find the Drowned Bell

quests.reminder: North-west, past Gull Point. A belfry standing in the sea. You can't miss it. I've tried.
outro: So it's still there. Good. Some tides it isn't.
The keepers ring it when the bay has given all it has. The tide turns. The islands forget, and start again kinder.
You won't forget. That's the keeper's share. Here, this was hers. It makes no sound, so mind who you blow it at.

quests.title: The Turning
quests.summary: Ring the Drowned Bell when the bay has nothing left to sell you.
intro: When you're ready, ring it. Your catch is sold and your coins go out with the tide. So does what coins did to your gear: the tuning, the creel, the bait.
What you keep: your rods, her things, your boat, your journal. And the Echoes. The more the tide carried, the more of them come back.
No hurry. You'll know the day. It's the day the stall has nothing left you want.

objectives.label: Ring the Drowned Bell

quests.reminder: The bell's where you left it, north-west past Gull Point. Ring it when the stall has nothing left you want.
outro: Morning. First time out here? No. No, I know you. I nearly always do.
Those are Echoes in your satchel. Spend them. They're the only coin that stays spent.
The fog's thinner on the far side of a Turning. Not thin enough to sail through. Thin enough to see where the road was.

quests.title: A Lamp for the Fog
quests.summary: Get a Fog Lamp for the bow of your boat: 8 Echoes, in your satchel.
intro: There was a road once, out through the fog. Iron lights, two lines of them, all the way to the Fen. They went out. Lights do.
A fog lamp would wake them. Keepers kept one on the bow. It burns what the Bell gives back, so coins won't buy it. Echoes will.
Eight of them. Look in your satchel, where the Echoes are. I'd tell you where the last lamp went, but I think it was on her boat.

objectives.label: Get the Fog Lamp with 8 Echoes (satchel, Echoes page)

quests.reminder: The lamp wants eight Echoes. If you're short, the Bell has more. It always has more.
outro: There she is, on the bow. She'll light herself when the fog comes close. Don't help her. She doesn't like it.
The road starts past the belfry, north-west. Two dead lights standing in the sea. Sail between them, and keep between them.
Off the road the fog is the fog still. It'll turn you round and tell you it was your idea.

quests.title: The Old Sea-Road
quests.summary: Sail the old sea-road through the fog to Mossglass Fen, and find the doctor on the landing.
intro: The Fen's the next water round. Green and still. Shallow enough to stand in, and deep enough not to.
There's a doctor out there, counting things. Came through on the packet before the lights went out. That can't be right, can it? Never mind.
Mara's a box on the landing, so you needn't sail home to sell. Tell the doctor the ferryman remembers her. She'll say we've not met.

objectives.label: Sail the sea-road, north-west of the Drowned Belfry, to Mossglass Fen

quests.reminder: Past the belfry, north-west, between the two lights. Keep to the road. The doctor's on the landing at the far end.
outro: A visitor! Splendid. Dr. Ines Calloway, natural history. Mind the tape, it's measuring.
The ferryman remembers me? How kind. We've not met. I came out on the packet, which, yes, does not run. I have decided not to mind.
Now. You fish, and I measure. The fen keeps coming out a different size, and I should like a second opinion.

quests.title: Fitted Out
quests.summary: Pay Pell 40,000 coins to float the Puffin off the flats and fit her out. Ask him about the boatyard.
intro: She wants a mast, a suit of sails and a great deal of paint. I want forty thousand. One of us will be disappointed, and it won't be her.
She'll carry more than the skiff and go quicker, and there's room aboard for two besides you. She draws more water, mind. The reeds will tell you where.

objectives.label: Pay Pell ◉ 40,000 to refit the Puffin (talk to Pell, then: the boatyard)

quests.reminder: Forty thousand for the Puffin. Ask me about the boatyard. The skiff stays yours. I'll mind whichever you're not sailing.
outro: There. She floats. She's a little surprised, I think. So am I.
I put the moorhen's nest back on the bar. She watched me do it. She'll be telling the reeds.
My brother's name is on the tiller still, underneath. Don't sand it. I can't read it either.

quests.title: A Sense of Scale
quests.summary: Catch six fish of the Fen for Dr. Calloway to weigh.
intro: First, a baseline. I need to know what a fish of this fen weighs when nobody is being clever about it.
Catch me six. Any sort, anywhere in the fen. I shall weigh them and write the numbers down, and we shall see if they stay written.
Sell them in Mara's box after. It gives stall prices. I have had it in pieces twice, and it is a box.

objectives.label: Catch 6 fish in Mossglass Fen

quests.reminder: Six fish of the fen, any sort. I've the scale ready. It was ready before you came, which I don't remember doing.
outro: Six. Thank you. Now watch the scale. There. And again. You saw that?
The same fish, a quarter of a pound heavier the second time. I am a careful woman. I do not think it is me.

quests.title: Clear as Glass
quests.summary: Catch a Glassfin in Glasswater, the still lagoon west of Sedge Landing.
intro: Glasswater next. The lagoon in the middle, west of here. Clear as a lens, and I want to know what it magnifies.
There's a little fish there you can see straight through. Glassfin. Bring me one whole. Try a mayfly on the hook.

objectives.label: Catch a Glassfin in Glasswater, west of the landing

quests.reminder: A Glassfin, from Glasswater. West of here, the still lagoon. You'll see the bottom all the way out.
outro: Lovely. Hold it to the light. You can read through it. I've tried: my own notes, quite legible.
Except this line. I didn't write that. 'She is on the far side.' It's in my hand. Well. I shall press it flat and think.

quests.title: The Tape Runs Out
quests.summary: Read the tape on Dr. Calloway's far stake, on the long bar in the Reed Maze.
intro: I ran a line across the Reed Maze, north of here. A stake at each end, and my best tape between.
It was two hundred yards when I set it. Sail up and read me the far stake, the one on the long bar. I can't leave the scale.
Mind the reed beds. The channels go round them, and so must you.

objectives.label: Read the tape on Calloway's stake in the Reed Maze, to the north

quests.reminder: The far stake, on the long bar in the Reed Maze. North of here. Just read me the number.
outro: Two hundred and forty? You're sure. No, I believe you. I believe the tape. That's what worries me.
Forty yards of fen that were not there on Tuesday. It isn't growing. Growing leaves marks. It's being remembered larger.
Here, you'll want a hat for this sun. That one's my spare. The tape in the band is not to be trusted either.

quests.title: A Boat in the Reeds
quests.summary: Look over the sloop that lies on the flats west of Calloway's stake, then ask Pell at Hearthbay whose she was.
intro: While you were at the stake, did you see a boat? West of it, on the flats. A fat little sloop with her mast down. I take bearings off her.
She has PUFFIN on the transom and a moorhen in the cockpit. She has not moved in my time, which is more than I can say for the fen.
Your ferryman would know whose she was. Look her over, and ask him. I should like one thing out here to have an explanation.

objectives.label: Look over the wreck on the flats, west of the stake in the Reed Maze

quests.reminder: The sloop on the flats, west of my stake in the Reed Maze. Bring the skiff alongside and look her over. Then ask your ferryman.
outro: The Puffin. My brother's. He took her into the Fen for eels the autumn the fog came down, and he walked home. He never said how.
A moorhen in the cockpit? Good. They won't nest in a boat that's finished. I can float her off and fit her out.
Forty thousand, and that's a brother's price. Ask me about the boatyard. I haven't got one. I shall have by the time you ask.

quests.title: What Glows
quests.summary: Catch a Glowbelly after dark among the Standing Trees, in the west of the Fen.
intro: The trees in the west light up after dark. The moss does, I mean. So does something in the water under them.
Glowbelly, the reed-cutters called it. Nobody has brought me one. Go at night, to the Standing Trees, and put something that glows on the hook.

objectives.label: Catch a Glowbelly at night among the Standing Trees, to the west

quests.reminder: A Glowbelly, after dark, under the Standing Trees. West, past Glasswater. A glowgrub on the hook wouldn't hurt.
outro: Oh, look at it. Into the jar. Now cover the jar. Still lit! It isn't reflecting anything. It's making it.
It brightens when I talk. Not when you do. Say something. No. Only me. How very flattering, and I do not like it at all.

quests.title: The Sump
quests.summary: Catch a Bottomless Eel in the Sump, the hole in the south-west of the Fen.
intro: South-west of the lagoon there's a hole. The Sump. I put a lead down it on four hundred fathoms of line.
It didn't touch. It's still going, as far as I know. I cut it loose on the third day.
Something lives in it. Long. I want to know how long. You'll need your strongest rod, and a worm.

objectives.label: Catch a Bottomless Eel in the Sump, south-west of Glasswater

quests.reminder: The Sump. South-west of Glasswater, where the water goes dark. A strong rod and a marsh worm.
outro: Hold the tail. I'll take the head. Five feet two. Now you hold the head. Six feet. Don't look at me like that.
I think it's the same with the fen. It is as big as whoever is measuring. And somebody a good deal bigger than us has started.

quests.title: The Listening Post
quests.summary: Put your ear to the trumpet at the Listening Post, on the far side of the Fen.
intro: Last one, and it isn't a measurement. On the far side, north-west past the trees, there's a platform on piles. Somebody built it to sit and listen.
There's a brass ear trumpet on it the size of a dinghy, pointed down at the water. I put my ear to it once. Once.
You go. You've the look of somebody it would rather talk to. There's a tin box by the stool. Bring me what's in it.

objectives.label: Put your ear to the trumpet at the Listening Post, north-west past the Standing Trees

quests.reminder: The Listening Post. North-west, past the trees, as far as the fen goes. Put your ear to the trumpet. Then come back.
outro: A page. One page, and the rest of the book gone. 'I. Fenn.' Do you know the name? No. Nor do I, and I keep nearly knowing it.
She sat there and wrote down what the water said. Read the last line. 'It is not the fish that listen.' Keep it. It was left for you, not for me.
And if something with no eyes comes up by the post at night, don't tell me how big it was. I shan't be able to stop myself.

quests.title: A Gentleman on the Road
quests.summary: A gentleman waits by the eighth light of the sea-road, out from the Fen. Bring a boat with a berth to spare and offer it to him.
intro: There is a gentleman on the sea-road. By the eighth light out from this end, standing on the water, with a bag. I have counted him four nights running.
He is waiting for the packet. I had not the heart to tell him, and I rather think he would not hear it. He is mostly fog.
Offer him a berth, would you? One of his own. He will not sit where a cat has sat. He was most particular, and I have not got a cat.

objectives.label: Have a berth to spare aboard (the Puffin has two)

quests.reminder: The eighth light out along the sea-road, on your right hand as you leave. He wants a berth of his own. He was most particular.
outro: Good evening. You are not the packet. No. But you have a seat, and I have been standing some time.
Hollis. I shall pay my passage in fish, if fish are acceptable. I keep a line in the bag. After dark, you understand. By day I am not at my best.
Pray do not trouble about the hour. It was a quarter past when I arrived, and I see it is a quarter past still.
